title: Sweden - 2026.08.10
notes: Sweden's inflation has dropped to its lowest levels in years, offering households a measure of relief after a prolonged cost-of-living squeeze. Yet the government's own admission that the country remains in a "protracted recession" tempers any optimism. Meanwhile, a combustible election-season battle over coalition power, immigration, and crime is reshaping the political terrain, with opinion polls showing the opposition bloc pulling ahead.
